invite.subject: Invitation: {title} · {when}
invite.title: {inviterName} invited you to a meeting
invite.memberNote: Open the link at meeting time; you can try your camera and microphone in the waiting room before joining.
invite.guestNote: You are joining as a guest: no account or install needed. Type your name in the browser and {inviterName} lets you in from the waiting room. The link stops working {hours} hours after the meeting.
invite.icsNote: Open the attached invite.ics to add it to your calendar.
invite.guestFooter: {inviterName} from {orgName} sent this invitation. You don't have an account, so you only get e-mails about this meeting.

update.subject: Updated: {title} · {when}
update.title: {title} was updated
update.body: {inviterName} changed the meeting details. The attached invitation updates the event in your calendar.

cancel.subject: Cancelled: {title} · {when}
cancel.title: {title} was cancelled
cancel.body: {inviterName} cancelled this meeting. The attached file removes the event from your calendar.
